ArgumentString.description: The NUL-terminated string an argument points to, as the file holds it.
ArgumentString.title: ArgumentString

CertificateData.description:
One WIN_CERTIFICATE entry of the certificate table: its header and the digest of
its content, which is neither decoded nor validated.
CertificateData.title: CertificateData

CodeFunctionData.description:
An x64 `.pdata` RUNTIME_FUNCTION entry: one contiguous range of one function,
as the file declares it.
CodeFunctionData.title: CodeFunctionData

CodeReachData.description:
Published calls to imports that the walk reaches from one root, following only
constant calls and jumps: from `main`, or from the entry point and the TLS callbacks
without entering `main` and not from `main` (the startup).
CodeReachData.title: CodeReachData

DotnetMemberData.description:
A row of the MemberRef table: a method or field the assembly names without
defining it in that row. `assembly` is set when its type belongs to another
assembly; a member of a constructed type (`type_spec`) carries no type name.
DotnetMemberData.title: DotnetMemberData

DotnetMetadataData.description:
The metadata root of a .NET assembly (evidence/dotnet.py): its streams, how many
rows its tables declare and the assemblies it names. The location is the root, up to
the end of its stream headers.
DotnetMetadataData.title: DotnetMetadataData

DotnetPinvokeData.description:
A row of the ImplMap table: a method the assembly forwards to native code
(P/Invoke). `module` and `function` are None when the row leaves that name empty, as
C++/CLI does for native code of the file itself.
DotnetPinvokeData.title: DotnetPinvokeData

DotnetStringData.description:
A literal of the #US stream, where the code's string literals are kept: printable
ASCII of at least four characters, read entry by entry. `index` is where its entry
starts in the stream.
DotnetStringData.title: DotnetStringData

DotnetTypeData.description:
A row of the TypeDef table: a type the assembly defines and how many methods of
the method table belong to it.
DotnetTypeData.title: DotnetTypeData

FrameSlot.description: A local variable: a displacement from the frame register.
FrameSlot.title: FrameSlot

Instruction.description: An instruction a claim rests on: where it is in the file and in the image.
Instruction.title: Instruction

LocalLinkData.description:
A call's parameter receives the address of a local variable (`phkResult`), and a
later call passes that variable's value (`hKey`): the value the first call leaves
there, if nothing in between changes it (the walk's rule).
LocalLinkData.title: LocalLinkData

MainCallData.description:
The direct call through which the compiler's startup enters `main`: its first
three arguments are the values of the variables whose addresses a call to
__getmainargs or __wgetmainargs (msvcrt.dll) received (evidence/main_forms.py).
MainCallData.title: MainCallData

OverlayData.description: Bytes after the last section that belong to no section and to no certificate.
OverlayData.title: OverlayData

PdbData.description:
A CodeView RSDS record that an entry of the debug directory points to: the
identifier and age that tie the file to its PDB, and the PDB path the linker wrote.
PdbData.title: PdbData

StringReferenceData.description:
An instruction of the walked code that takes the address where a published string
starts (evidence/reference_forms.py).
StringReferenceData.title: StringReferenceData

ToolchainData.description:
Bytes of the catalog's exact form of a marker that a compiler, linker or
packager leaves in the file (evidence/toolchain.py).
ToolchainData.title: ToolchainData

UpxImageData.description:
A UPX 5 block (evidence/upx.py): its header, where its packed bytes are, and what
the unpacked bytes declare about the original program. The unpacked bytes are
identified by their size, Adler-32 and SHA-256, and the host derives them again.
UpxImageData.title: UpxImageData

UpxImportData.description:
A function in the import list of a UPX block: the loader resolves it and writes
its address in the original program's import slot `iat_rva`. The entry lies in the
unpacked bytes; the DLL's name, in the packed file.
UpxImportData.title: UpxImportData

UpxSection.description: A section of the original program, as the header copy in the block lists it.
UpxSection.title: UpxSection

UpxStringData.description:
A literal string of the rebuilt image of a UPX block (evidence/upx.py, `rebuild`),
found with the same method as the sample's strings, at `rva` of the original program.
UpxStringData.title: UpxStringData

VersionStringData.description: One String block of a version resource: text the file declares about itself.
VersionStringData.title: VersionStringData
